Developer. Builder. Problem Solver.

I'm GowriSankaran Ganesan, a full-stack web developer from Bodinaykanur, studying at V.S.B. Engineering College, Karur. I build apps end-to-end — from UI design to database architecture — and I care deeply about making things that actually work for real users.

My projects span social platforms, e-commerce systems, agriculture tech, and collaborative tools — all built with a focus on clean architecture and practical functionality.

Beyond code, you'll find me exploring music, attending tech workshops (IIT Madras, Bannari Amman IT), and thinking about how software can solve problems that matter.
